conviction_note: Event double-confirmed from primary documents (both the 2026-05-22 Q1 6-K and the 2026-06-29 6-K list 'September 21, 2026 - Half-year 2026 financial results'), and the two things the sweep pointed me at are already resolved and priced: the financing question was answered by a $920m raise at $125.00/ADS closed 2026-07-06 that funds operations 'into the second quarter of 2029' per the 424B5, and the ENHANCE-CD slip from Q4 2026 to mid-2027 was disclosed on 2026-06-29. Rebuilding the base rate from confirmed financial releases only (not the untrustworthy baseline history), this name's non-clinical prints moved -4.55% (FY2025, 2026-03-23) and +3.62% (Q1 2026, 2026-05-22), so the scale is ~3.5% and roughly symmetric; I found nothing large. My two numbers deliberately disagree: I think the H1 loss lands well wider than the $1.08/ADS aggregator bar (print_vs_bar -20) and I expect that to be worth almost nothing to the stock, because a $9bn clinical-stage biotech with 2029 runway does not trade on a half-year P&L. The small positive is a positioning read, and it is deliberately held only +0.3 above the +0.2 sum of findings because it AGREES with the 25d skew (-11.51, calls bid) and with the run-up-reversal control, i.e. most of it is already in the price; the residual is the 8-day-to-cover short into a benign print, which a 9,137-contract chain quoted at 50% of mid cannot have priced properly.
bar: Aggregator consensus of a $1.08 loss per ADS on ~$1.86m revenue for H1 2026 (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/abivax-h1fy26-results-loss-expected-1-08-per-share/50922364). This is effectively UNSOURCED to a company guide and rests on one aggregator page; Abivax gives no financial guidance at all. Under LESSONS.md #6 every finding on this name is therefore capped at a small size (max |1.0|) and I say so here. My -20 read is an inference, not a document: Q1 2026 net loss was EUR 48.5m on ~78.7m pre-offering ordinary shares (~$0.72/ADS) per https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001956827/000195682726000022/a6-kpressreleaseq12026fina.htm, so two quarters at or above that run rate (Q2 added the commercial build-out announced 2026-07-23) implies ~$1.45-1.55 of loss per ADS against the $1.08 bar. Q2 non-operating items (French CIR, EUR/USD on a large USD cash balance) could move this materially in either direction.
positioning_check: Short interest 6,960,000 shares = 8.07% of shares outstanding, short ratio 8.05 days to cover, up from 6,000,000 the prior settlement (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/abvx/statistics/, read 2026-09-21). Percent of float is not published by that source. The 8.07% cross-checks against the 86,094,535-87,054,535 ordinary shares outstanding after the July offering stated in the 424B5 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001956827/000119312526294491/d111359d424b5.htm), so the denominator is right. I could not independently re-fetch Nasdaq's short interest table (HTTP 503), so this is a single source. Skew: the baseline's 25d skew is -11.51 vol points, i.e. CALLS are bid over puts by 11.5 vols - the option market's out-loud statement here is bullish, which is the same direction as my net finding, so my sign is with the market and not against it. That is a reason to shrink, not to size up. The skew is also weak evidence: total open interest 9,137 contracts and the ATM bid-ask is 50% of mid, per the baseline's own warning. Additional positioning fact: 7,360,000 ADSs (~8.5% of the post-deal company) were placed at $125.00 on 2026-07-01 and spot is $103.08, so that book is 17.5% underwater eleven weeks later.

findings.finding: Into a low-information print, ABVX carries 8.07% of shares outstanding short at 8.05 days to cover (up from 6.00m shares the prior settlement), sits 17.5% below the $125.00 price at which 7.36m ADSs (~8.5% of the company) were placed on 2026-07-01, and has drifted -10.3% over 20 sessions with no company news since 2026-07-30 - while every overhang that produced that drift has been resolved in a primary document (financing: 'into the second quarter of 2029' runway in the 424B5; regulatory: FDA alignment on NDA content and format on 2026-07-30).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline's history is flagged untrustworthy and I did not use it. Rebuilt from confirmed financial releases only: 2026-05-22 (Q1 2026 results, bundled with Study 108 three-year data) +3.62%; 2026-03-23 (FY2025 results) -4.55%. The two largest moves in the baseline, -44.1% on 2026-06-02 and +38.6% on 2026-06-29, are ABTECT clinical readouts and are not an earnings base rate. So this name's financial prints move ~3.5% with no directional bias; this finding is sized at a fifth of that scale because a squeeze needs a trigger and a half-year P&L is a weak one.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced, and I have sized it as such. If the market had fully priced the squeeze risk into this print you would see it in the option chain, and the chain has 9,137 contracts of total open interest with a 50%-of-mid ATM spread - there is no real hedging demand there to price it. What IS visible is the skew at -11.51 (calls bid), which says the direction is at least partly paid for; that is exactly why this is 0.7 and not 2.5. The genuinely unpriced piece is narrow: consensus wire copy still describes the runway question as open (the sweep brief itself framed 'the gap between runway and a commercial launch' as the edge), when the 424B5 answered it as Q2 2029 eleven weeks ago.
findings.independence: The short-interest level and days to cover come from a different source than the deal price and runway (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/abvx/statistics/, read 2026-09-21, against the SEC 424B5). The deal price and size are corroborated by a third source, https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/01/3320607/0/en/Abivax-Announces-Pricing-of-Oversubscribed-and-Upsized-800M-702M-Public-Offering-of-American-Depositary-Shares.html. The run-up figure is from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: The EMA MAA for obefazimod, guided for the second half of 2026 contingent on positive ABTECT maintenance data, has been absent from Abivax's own 'Anticipated Key Milestones' list in every release since that condition was met - the 2026-06-01 maintenance topline 6-K mentions no EMA, MAA, European marketing authorization or European regulatory pathway at all, and the 2026-06-29 list carries only three items (H1 results, NDA Q4 2026, ENHANCE-CD mid-2027).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent on this line for this name. The nearest comparable is the ENHANCE-CD Crohn's induction readout, which slipped from 'Q4 2026' in the 2026-05-22 Q1 release to 'mid-2027' in the 2026-06-29 release; that day the stock rose 38.6%, because the slip was buried inside a positive Phase 3 readout. That is the honest precedent: this shareholder base has already looked through one timeline slip in the milestone list without pricing it, which is the main reason this is -0.3 and not -1.5.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had priced an EU deprioritisation you would see EU launch value being stripped from targets; instead every price target moved UP after the maintenance data (Piper $175 2026-07-09, Morgan Stanley $180 2026-07-24, Citizens JMP $187 2026-07-01) and no preview I found mentions Europe at all. The wire copy is uniformly 'NDA Q4 2026' with no EU line. H2 2026 has fourteen weeks left and tonight's release is the natural place for the milestone to be reinstated or formally deferred; a deferral to 2027 is a real, if small, NPV item that nobody is carrying.
findings.independence: Partly self-contained: the ABSENCE is established in a primary SEC document I fetched, but the original 'MAA to the EMA in the second half of 2026' guidance I could only reach as a search snippet of https://ir.abivax.com/news-releases/news-release-details/abivax-announces-positive-phase-3-results-both-abtect-8-week (ir.abivax.com returned HTTP 503 on six separate fetch attempts today), so mark that half snippet_only. A second, independent primary document points the same way: the 424B5 of 2026-07-01 discusses only the FDA NDA and gives no EU timing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001956827/000119312526294491/d111359d424b5.htm). This finding shares no document with finding 1's positioning evidence.

findings.finding: The H1 2026 balance sheet is dated 30 June 2026 and therefore predates the 6 July closing of the $920m offering, so the headline cash figure will be roughly EUR 425-440m - visibly DOWN from the EUR 491.6m reported at 31 March - and the half-year loss per ADS should land near $1.45-1.55 against the $1.08 aggregator bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the line LESSONS.md #1 says to veto. Abivax has never been shown to trade on its reported P&L: the FY2025 results print moved -4.55% and the Q1 2026 print +3.62%, and the Q1 print was positive on the Study 108 data bundled with it rather than on the numbers. A clinical-stage biotech with a stated runway into Q2 2029 has no mechanism by which a half-year EPS miss reaches the multiple. Sized at a tenth of the name's reaction scale for that reason.
findings.why_not_priced: Not so much unpriced as mechanically mis-scrapable: the period-end date falls five days before the financing closed, so headline algorithms and any reader anchored on the post-deal cash pile will see a 12% sequential cash decline and an EPS number well wide of the one aggregator print that exists. If the market had this right you would see previews distinguishing the 30 June balance sheet from the pro-forma; the one preview I found simply repeats '$1.08 loss on $1.86m revenue'. The effect is almost certainly a first-hour artefact that reverses before the exit, which is why it is -0.2 and not larger.
findings.independence: This finding and finding 1 both rest in part on the same 424B5 for the offering close date and share count - say so and count it once. The Q1 cash and loss figures are from a different primary document (the Q1 6-K), and the $1.08 bar is from a third source (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/abivax-h1fy26-results-loss-expected-1-08-per-share/50922364).
